---- MODULE W4Od3m8p1t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Banks, Accounts, Opening
NONE == "none"
VARIABLES coarse, fine, balance, committed, crashed, postedTo
vars == <<coarse, fine, balance, committed, crashed, postedTo>>

TypeInvariant ==
    /\ coarse \in Banks \cup {NONE}
    /\ fine \in [Accounts -> Banks \cup {NONE}]
    /\ balance \in [Accounts -> Nat]
    /\ committed \subseteq Banks
    /\ crashed \subseteq Banks
    /\ postedTo \in [Banks -> Accounts \cup {NONE}]

Init ==
    /\ coarse = NONE
    /\ fine = [a \in Accounts |-> NONE]
    /\ balance = [a \in Accounts |-> Opening]
    /\ committed = {}
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ postedTo = [b \in Banks |-> NONE]

AcquireCoarse(b) ==
    /\ b \notin crashed
    /\ b \notin committed
    /\ coarse = NONE
    /\ coarse' = b
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, balance, committed, crashed, postedTo>>

AcquireFine(b, a) ==
    /\ b \notin crashed
    /\ coarse = b
    /\ postedTo[b] = NONE
    /\ fine[a] = NONE
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![a] = b]
    /\ postedTo' = [postedTo EXCEPT ![b] = a]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, balance, committed, crashed>>

Commit(b) ==
    /\ b \notin crashed
    /\ coarse = b
    /\ postedTo[b] \in Accounts
    /\ fine[postedTo[b]] = b
    /\ b \notin committed
    /\ balance' = [balance EXCEPT ![postedTo[b]] = @ + 1]
    /\ committed' = committed \cup {b}
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![postedTo[b]] = NONE]
    /\ coarse' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<crashed, postedTo>>

Crash(b) ==
    /\ b \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {b}
    /\ coarse' = IF coarse = b THEN NONE ELSE coarse
    /\ fine' = [a \in Accounts |-> IF fine[a] = b THEN NONE ELSE fine[a]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<balance, committed, postedTo>>

Done ==
    /\ \A b \in Banks : (b \in committed \/ b \in crashed)
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Banks : AcquireCoarse(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks, a \in Accounts : AcquireFine(b, a)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Commit(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Crash(b)
    \/ Done

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdate ==
    \A a \in Accounts :
        balance[a] - Opening = Cardinality({b \in committed : postedTo[b] = a})
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Banks = {b1, b2, b3}
    Accounts = {a1, a2}
    Opening = 0
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
An interbank settlement batch is processed by several member banks that each post one credit to the shared clearing ledger. There are two levels of lock: a single coarse lock over the whole ledger, and a per-account fine lock. To post its credit a bank must first take the coarse ledger lock, then take the fine lock on the account it chooses (a fine lock may only be taken by a bank that already holds the coarse lock), which records that account as its posting target. While holding both locks the bank commits: it adds exactly one unit to that account's balance, records itself as having committed, and releases both locks. Each bank posts at most once. A bank can crash silently at any time; on crashing it releases any locks it was holding and never commits afterward. The system must guarantee that money posted is never lost or double-counted under the crashes and interleavings.
SAFETY PROPERTY: for every account, its balance minus the opening balance equals exactly the number of banks that have committed a credit to that account.

---- MODULE W4Od4m1p2t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS N, Cap, TotalCars
NONE == 999
Stations == 0 .. (N - 1)
Nxt(s) == (s + 1) % N
VARIABLES holder, pending, cars
vars == <<holder, pending, cars>>

RECURSIVE SumOf(_)
SumOf(S) == IF S = {} THEN 0
            ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN cars[x] + SumOf(S \ {x})

WellFormed ==
    /\ holder \in Stations \cup {NONE}
    /\ pending \subseteq Stations
    /\ cars \in [Stations -> 0 .. TotalCars]

Init ==
    /\ holder = 0
    /\ pending = {}
    /\ cars = [s \in Stations |-> IF s = 0 THEN TotalCars ELSE 0]

Convey(s) ==
    /\ holder = s
    /\ cars[s] > 0
    /\ cars[Nxt(s)] < Cap
    /\ cars' = [cars EXCEPT ![s] = @ - 1, ![Nxt(s)] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, pending>>

ReleaseToken(s) ==
    /\ holder = s
    /\ holder' = NONE
    /\ pending' = pending \cup {Nxt(s)}
    /\ UNCHANGED cars

Deliver(d) ==
    /\ d \in pending
    /\ holder = NONE
    /\ holder' = d
    /\ pending' = pending \ {d}
    /\ UNCHANGED cars

Quiesce ==
    /\ holder = NONE
    /\ pending = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Stations : Convey(s)
    \/ \E s \in Stations : ReleaseToken(s)
    \/ \E d \in Stations : Deliver(d)
    \/ Quiesce

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CarConservation == SumOf(Stations) = TotalCars
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    N = 4
    Cap = 3
    TotalCars = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CarConservation
nl:
An automated car-wash line is arranged as a ring of wash stations. Cars sit at stations and are conveyed one hop at a time around the ring. A single circulating token grants the exclusive right to act: only the station currently holding the token may push its front car to the next station, provided that neighbour still has room. When a station is finished it releases the token by emitting a grant message addressed to its ring-neighbour; grant messages travel through an unordered control medium, so a released grant sits pending until it is delivered, and deliveries may interleave arbitrarily with conveyor moves. Cars are never added or removed once the batch starts running; they only shift between adjacent stations. The operator wants an assurance that the conveyor neither manufactures nor loses a car no matter how token deliveries and moves interleave.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the total number of cars summed over all stations always equals the fixed number of cars loaded at the start.

---- MODULE W4Od3m2p3t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Engines, Slots
NONE == "none"
VARIABLES want, reserved, owner, estate
vars == <<want, reserved, owner, estate>>

WellFormed ==
    /\ want \in [Engines -> Slots \cup {NONE}]
    /\ reserved \in [Slots -> Engines \cup {NONE}]
    /\ owner \in [Slots -> Engines \cup {NONE}]
    /\ estate \in [Engines -> {"idle", "preparing", "committed", "aborted"}]

Init ==
    /\ want = [e \in Engines |-> NONE]
    /\ reserved = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ owner = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ estate = [e \in Engines |-> "idle"]

Begin(e, s) ==
    /\ estate[e] = "idle"
    /\ want' = [want EXCEPT ![e] = s]
    /\ estate' = [estate EXCEPT ![e] = "preparing"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reserved, owner>>

VoteYes(e) ==
    /\ estate[e] = "preparing"
    /\ want[e] \in Slots
    /\ reserved[want[e]] = NONE
    /\ reserved' = [reserved EXCEPT ![want[e]] = e]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<want, owner, estate>>

Abort(e) ==
    /\ estate[e] = "preparing"
    /\ want[e] \in Slots
    /\ reserved[want[e]] \notin {NONE, e}
    /\ estate' = [estate EXCEPT ![e] = "aborted"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<want, reserved, owner>>

CommitTxn(e) ==
    /\ estate[e] = "preparing"
    /\ want[e] \in Slots
    /\ reserved[want[e]] = e
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![want[e]] = e]
    /\ estate' = [estate EXCEPT ![e] = "committed"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<want, reserved>>

Settled ==
    /\ \A e \in Engines : estate[e] \in {"committed", "aborted"}
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E e \in Engines, s \in Slots : Begin(e, s)
    \/ \E e \in Engines : VoteYes(e)
    \/ \E e \in Engines : Abort(e)
    \/ \E e \in Engines : CommitTxn(e)
    \/ Settled

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

ExclusiveAllocation ==
    \A s \in Slots :
        /\ (owner[s] # NONE => reserved[s] = owner[s])
        /\ (\A e \in Engines :
                (estate[e] = "committed" /\ want[e] = s) => owner[s] = e)
====
nl:
Two independent settlement engines draw slots from one shared pool of settlement slots to finalise interbank transfers. Each engine runs a two-phase commit for the single slot it wants. In the prepare phase the engine asks the slot's resource manager to vote: the slot votes yes and becomes reserved to that engine only if it is currently unreserved, otherwise the engine sees the slot already reserved by its rival and aborts. In the commit phase the engine, holding a yes vote, finalises ownership of the slot. Because both engines pull from the same pool, the danger is that a race lets both finalise the same slot. Ownership is only ever granted to the engine that actually reserved the slot in phase one.
SAFETY PROPERTY: any slot that has been finalised is owned by exactly the engine that reserved it, and no committed engine can own a slot reserved by another engine.

---- MODULE W4Od14m4p6t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Drones, Tasks, QCap, MaxEpoch
NONE == "none"
VARIABLES queue, assigned, completed, badge, curEpoch
vars == <<queue, assigned, completed, badge, curEpoch>>

WellFormed ==
    /\ queue \subseteq Tasks
    /\ assigned \in [Tasks -> Drones \cup {NONE}]
    /\ completed \subseteq Tasks
    /\ badge \in [Drones -> 0 .. MaxEpoch]
    /\ curEpoch \in 0 .. MaxEpoch

Init ==
    /\ queue = {}
    /\ assigned = [t \in Tasks |-> NONE]
    /\ completed = {}
    /\ badge = [d \in Drones |-> 0]
    /\ curEpoch = 0

Enqueue(t) ==
    /\ t \notin queue
    /\ t \notin completed
    /\ assigned[t] = NONE
    /\ Cardinality(queue) < QCap
    /\ queue' = queue \cup {t}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<assigned, completed, badge, curEpoch>>

Claim(d, t) ==
    /\ t \in queue
    /\ assigned[t] = NONE
    /\ badge[d] = curEpoch
    /\ assigned' = [assigned EXCEPT ![t] = d]
    /\ queue' = queue \ {t}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<completed, badge, curEpoch>>

Complete(d, t) ==
    /\ assigned[t] = d
    /\ badge[d] = curEpoch
    /\ completed' = completed \cup {t}
    /\ assigned' = [assigned EXCEPT ![t] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, badge, curEpoch>>

Rotate ==
    /\ curEpoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ curEpoch' = curEpoch + 1
    /\ queue' = queue \cup {t \in Tasks : assigned[t] # NONE}
    /\ assigned' = [t \in Tasks |-> NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<completed, badge>>

Refresh(d) ==
    /\ badge[d] < curEpoch
    /\ badge' = [badge EXCEPT ![d] = curEpoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, assigned, completed, curEpoch>>

Quiesce == UNCHANGED vars /\ completed = Tasks

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Tasks : Enqueue(t)
    \/ \E d \in Drones, t \in Tasks : Claim(d, t)
    \/ \E d \in Drones, t \in Tasks : Complete(d, t)
    \/ Rotate
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Refresh(d)
    \/ Quiesce

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

AuthorizedHolders ==
    \A t \in Tasks : assigned[t] # NONE => badge[assigned[t]] = curEpoch
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Drones = {d1, d2}
    Tasks = {t1, t2}
    QCap = 2
    MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT AuthorizedHolders
nl:
A wildfire surveillance swarm is coordinated by a dispatcher holding a bounded queue of survey tasks. Tasks wait in the queue in no particular order, and new tasks are only admitted while the queue has spare capacity, giving backpressure. Every drone carries a badge stamped with an epoch; the swarm has a current epoch. A drone may claim a waiting task and later complete it only while its badge epoch matches the current swarm epoch. Periodically the ground station rotates the swarm epoch (for example after a security refresh); rotation immediately invalidates every in-progress assignment, returning those tasks to the queue, so any drone still carrying an old badge becomes stale and must re-badge before it can act again. The guarantee sought is that a stale or unauthorised drone can never be the holder of an active task assignment.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every task that is currently assigned is held by a drone whose badge epoch equals the current swarm epoch.

---- MODULE W4Od3m6p3t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Participants, Slots, MaxT, LeaseLen
NONE == "none"
VARIABLES clock, holder, expiry, settled, crashed
vars == <<clock, holder, expiry, settled, crashed>>

WellFormed ==
    /\ clock \in 0 .. MaxT
    /\ holder \in [Slots -> Participants \cup {NONE}]
    /\ expiry \in [Slots -> 0 .. MaxT]
    /\ settled \in [Slots -> Participants \cup {NONE}]
    /\ crashed \subseteq Participants

Init ==
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ holder = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ expiry = [s \in Slots |-> 0]
    /\ settled = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ crashed = {}

Acquire(p, s) ==
    /\ p \notin crashed
    /\ holder[s] = NONE
    /\ settled[s] = NONE
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![s] = p]
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![s] = IF clock + LeaseLen > MaxT THEN MaxT ELSE clock + LeaseLen]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, settled, crashed>>

Renew(p, s) ==
    /\ p \notin crashed
    /\ holder[s] = p
    /\ expiry[s] >= clock
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![s] = IF clock + LeaseLen > MaxT THEN MaxT ELSE clock + LeaseLen]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, holder, settled, crashed>>

Settle(p, s) ==
    /\ p \notin crashed
    /\ holder[s] = p
    /\ expiry[s] >= clock
    /\ settled[s] = NONE
    /\ settled' = [settled EXCEPT ![s] = p]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, holder, expiry, crashed>>

Reclaim(s) ==
    /\ holder[s] # NONE
    /\ expiry[s] < clock
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, expiry, settled, crashed>>

Crash(p) ==
    /\ p \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, holder, expiry, settled>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxT
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, expiry, settled, crashed>>

Halt == UNCHANGED vars /\ clock = MaxT

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Participants, s \in Slots : Acquire(p, s)
    \/ \E p \in Participants, s \in Slots : Renew(p, s)
    \/ \E p \in Participants, s \in Slots : Settle(p, s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Reclaim(s)
    \/ \E p \in Participants : Crash(p)
    \/ Tick
    \/ Halt

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

SettledSlotNotStolen ==
    \A s \in Slots :
        settled[s] # NONE => holder[s] \in {settled[s], NONE}
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Participants = {p1, p2}
    Slots = {s1, s2}
    MaxT = 3
    LeaseLen = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT SettledSlotNotStolen
nl:
A settlement batch hands out settlement slots to member participants using time-limited leases. A free slot may be leased by a participant, which stamps the lease with an expiry a fixed span into the future measured on a shared clock. A participant holding a live (unexpired) lease may renew it, and may settle the slot, which permanently records that slot as allocated to that participant. Once a slot has been settled it is never re-leased. A lease whose expiry has passed can be reclaimed, clearing the holder so a fresh, unsettled slot could be leased again. The clock only moves forward. Any participant may crash silently at any moment; a crashed participant stops acting and its leases simply age out. The batch must guarantee a slot is never re-allocated away to a different participant once it has been settled.
SAFETY PROPERTY: for every slot that has been settled to a participant, the slot's current holder is either that same participant or nobody, never a different participant.

---- MODULE W4Od7m3p6t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Cranes, MaxTerm, MaxCap
NONE == "none"
VARIABLES term, leader, craneTerm, capacity, active
vars == <<term, leader, craneTerm, capacity, active>>

WellFormed ==
    /\ term \in 0 .. MaxTerm
    /\ leader \in Cranes \cup {NONE}
    /\ craneTerm \in [Cranes -> 0 .. MaxTerm]
    /\ capacity \in 1 .. MaxCap
    /\ active \in 0 .. MaxCap

Init ==
    /\ term = 0
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ craneTerm = [c \in Cranes |-> 0]
    /\ capacity = 1
    /\ active = 0

Elect(c) ==
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ leader' = c
    /\ craneTerm' = [craneTerm EXCEPT ![c] = term + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<capacity, active>>

FailLeader(c) ==
    /\ leader = c
    /\ leader' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, craneTerm, capacity, active>>

Authorize(c) ==
    /\ leader = c
    /\ craneTerm[c] = term
    /\ active < capacity
    /\ active' = active + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, craneTerm, capacity>>

CompleteMove ==
    /\ active > 0
    /\ active' = active - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, craneTerm, capacity>>

Reconfigure(k) ==
    /\ k >= active
    /\ capacity' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, craneTerm, active>>

Halt == UNCHANGED vars /\ term = MaxTerm /\ active = 0

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Elect(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : FailLeader(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Authorize(c)
    \/ CompleteMove
    \/ \E k \in 1 .. MaxCap : Reconfigure(k)
    \/ Halt

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

LeaderTermCurrent ==
    leader # NONE => craneTerm[leader] = term
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Cranes = {k1, k2, k3}
    MaxTerm = 3
    MaxCap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT LeaderTermCurrent
nl:
A container-ship crane yard is coordinated by one elected lead crane that authorises yard moves. Each crane remembers the election term it last participated in, and the yard has a global current term. Running an election picks a new lead crane and advances the global term by one, stamping that new leader with the new term. The lead crane may fail, which vacates the leadership and forces a fresh election (failover). Only a crane that is currently the leader and whose remembered term matches the global term may authorise a move, and moves in flight must stay within the yard's capacity. The yard's capacity is reconfigured at runtime as bays open and close. The essential guarantee is that leadership is never held by a stale crane running on an out-of-date term.
SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever there is a sitting lead crane, that crane's remembered election term equals the yard's current global term.

---- MODULE W4Od19m4p5t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Books, Patrons, QCap, MaxOverrides
NONE == "none"
VARIABLES reqQueue, reserver, issuedTo, overrides
vars == <<reqQueue, reserver, issuedTo, overrides>>

WellFormed ==
    /\ reqQueue \subseteq (Books \X Patrons)
    /\ reserver \in [Books -> Patrons \cup {NONE}]
    /\ issuedTo \in [Books -> Patrons \cup {NONE}]
    /\ overrides \in 0 .. MaxOverrides

Init ==
    /\ reqQueue = {}
    /\ reserver = [b \in Books |-> NONE]
    /\ issuedTo = [b \in Books |-> NONE]
    /\ overrides = 0

Submit(b, p) ==
    /\ <<b, p>> \notin reqQueue
    /\ reserver[b] = NONE
    /\ issuedTo[b] = NONE
    /\ Cardinality(reqQueue) < QCap
    /\ reqQueue' = reqQueue \cup {<<b, p>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reserver, issuedTo, overrides>>

Grant(b, p) ==
    /\ <<b, p>> \in reqQueue
    /\ reserver[b] = NONE
    /\ issuedTo[b] = NONE
    /\ reserver' = [reserver EXCEPT ![b] = p]
    /\ reqQueue' = reqQueue \ {<<b, p>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<issuedTo, overrides>>

CheckOut(b) ==
    /\ reserver[b] # NONE
    /\ issuedTo[b] = NONE
    /\ issuedTo' = [issuedTo EXCEPT ![b] = reserver[b]]
    /\ reserver' = [reserver EXCEPT ![b] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reqQueue, overrides>>

AdminOverride(b, p) ==
    /\ issuedTo[b] = NONE
    /\ overrides < MaxOverrides
    /\ issuedTo' = [issuedTo EXCEPT ![b] = p]
    /\ reserver' = [reserver EXCEPT ![b] = NONE]
    /\ reqQueue' = {r \in reqQueue : r[1] # b}
    /\ overrides' = overrides + 1

Idle == UNCHANGED vars /\ \A b \in Books : issuedTo[b] # NONE

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Books, p \in Patrons : Submit(b, p)
    \/ \E b \in Books, p \in Patrons : Grant(b, p)
    \/ \E b \in Books : CheckOut(b)
    \/ \E b \in Books, p \in Patrons : AdminOverride(b, p)
    \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

IssuedConsumesReservation ==
    \A b \in Books : issuedTo[b] # NONE => reserver[b] = NONE
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Books = {b1, b2}
    Patrons = {p1, p2}
    QCap = 2
    MaxOverrides = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT IssuedConsumesReservation
nl:
A library reservation service manages checkouts of individual books by patrons. Reservation requests for a book by a patron wait in a bounded request queue; a new request is only admitted while the queue has spare room, providing backpressure. A queued request may be granted, which makes that patron the book's reserver, provided the book is neither already reserved nor already checked out. A reserved book may be checked out to its reserver: checkout is the irreversible action - it permanently records who holds the book and consumes the reservation. A privileged librarian may override the normal flow and issue a book directly to any patron, skipping the queue and reservation steps, but even the override cannot issue a book that has already been checked out. Because checkout is irreversible, the design must ensure a book cannot be checked out a second time: the reservation that enables a checkout is destroyed as the checkout happens.
SAFETY PROPERTY: any book that has been checked out to a patron has no outstanding reservation, so no second checkout of that book can be triggered.

---- MODULE W4Od17m7p3t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Bags, Chutes, MaxVer, MaxForce
NONE == "none"
VARIABLES reg, assign, version, forces
vars == <<reg, assign, version, forces>>

WellFormed ==
    /\ reg \in [Chutes -> Bags \cup {NONE}]
    /\ assign \in [Bags -> Chutes \cup {NONE}]
    /\ version \in [Chutes -> 0 .. MaxVer]
    /\ forces \in 0 .. MaxForce

Init ==
    /\ reg = [c \in Chutes |-> NONE]
    /\ assign = [b \in Bags |-> NONE]
    /\ version = [c \in Chutes |-> 0]
    /\ forces = 0

CasRoute(b, c) ==
    /\ reg[c] = NONE
    /\ assign[b] = NONE
    /\ version[c] < MaxVer
    /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![c] = b]
    /\ assign' = [assign EXCEPT ![b] = c]
    /\ version' = [version EXCEPT ![c] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED forces

Release(b, c) ==
    /\ reg[c] = b
    /\ assign[b] = c
    /\ version[c] < MaxVer
    /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![c] = NONE]
    /\ assign' = [assign EXCEPT ![b] = NONE]
    /\ version' = [version EXCEPT ![c] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED forces

ForceRoute(b, c) ==
    /\ forces < MaxForce
    /\ assign[b] = NONE
    /\ version[c] < MaxVer
    /\ LET prev == reg[c] IN
        assign' = [x \in Bags |-> IF x = b THEN c
                                  ELSE IF x = prev THEN NONE
                                  ELSE assign[x]]
    /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![c] = b]
    /\ version' = [version EXCEPT ![c] = @ + 1]
    /\ forces' = forces + 1

Idle == UNCHANGED vars /\ \A c \in Chutes : version[c] = MaxVer

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Bags, c \in Chutes : CasRoute(b, c)
    \/ \E b \in Bags, c \in Chutes : Release(b, c)
    \/ \E b \in Bags, c \in Chutes : ForceRoute(b, c)
    \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

RegisterAssignAgree ==
    \A c \in Chutes : \A b \in Bags :
        (reg[c] = b) <=> (assign[b] = c)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Bags = {g1, g2}
    Chutes = {c1, c2}
    MaxVer = 3
    MaxForce = 1
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT RegisterAssignAgree
nl:
An airport baggage router assigns bags to discharge chutes. Each chute exposes an atomic register holding the id of the bag that owns it (or nobody) together with a version counter. A bag is routed to a chute by a compare-and-swap: the router succeeds only if the chute's register currently reads empty and the bag is not already routed anywhere, and on success it writes the bag into the register, records the chute as that bag's assignment, and bumps the version. A routed bag may be released, clearing both the register and its assignment and bumping the version. A privileged operator may force a bag onto any chute, bypassing the compare-and-swap emptiness check and evicting whatever bag previously owned that chute (clearing the evicted bag's assignment). The invariant to protect is that the chute registers and the bags' assignment records stay in perfect agreement, so no chute holds two bags and no bag is routed to two chutes.
SAFETY PROPERTY: for every chute and bag, the chute's register names that bag if and only if the bag's assignment record names that chute.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od3m1p5t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS N
NONE == 999

A car-wash line feeds cars into a single wash bay, which is the critical resource that may serve only one car at a time. Cars wait in the queue in no fixed order because the entry tickets are handled by an unordered controller, so any waiting car may be selected next. Two independent library service instances share a single pool of physical book copies and hand them out to patrons. Each copy is guarded by an atomic register holding the patron who currently owns the copy (or nobody) plus a version counter. To lend a copy, an instance performs a compare-and-swap: it succeeds only if the copy's register reads empty at the version the instance expected and the target patron is not already holding a copy; on success it writes the patron into the register, records that copy as the patron's held copy, bumps the version, and notes which instance made the write. A held copy may be returned, clearing the register and the patron's record and bumping the version. The register and the patrons' held-copy records must stay mutually consistent.
SAFETY PROPERTY: a copy's register names a patron exactly when that patron's held-copy record names that copy, so no copy is lent twice and no patron holds two copies.

    /\ m \notin crashed
    /\ m \notin submitted

    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, crashed>>

    /\ UNCHANGED <<submitted, crashed, order>>

Crash(m) ==
    /\ m \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {m}
    /\ holder' = IF holder = m THEN NONE ELSE holder
    /\ UNCHANGED <<submitted, order>>

Reissue(h) ==
    /\ holder = NONE
    /\ h \notin crashed
    /\ holder' = h
    /\ UNCHANGED <<submitted, crashed, order>>

    \/ \E m \in Makers : PassToken(m)
    \/ \E m \in Makers : Crash(m)
    \/ \E h \in Makers : Reissue(h)

    N = 3
    Prices = {10, 20}
INIT Init
NEXT Next

nl:
At a stock exchange opening auction, registered market makers arranged in a ring take turns submitting their single opening order. A token circulates the ring and only its current holder may act. The holder may submit its opening order once, choosing a price: submission is irreversible, recording the maker as having submitted and fixing its order price permanently. The holder may instead pass the token to the next maker in the ring. A market maker can crash silently at any point; a crashed maker stops acting, and if the crash strikes the token holder the token is dropped. A watchdog may reissue a dropped token to any live maker so the auction can proceed. Each maker must submit at most once, so the recorded submission set and the fixed order prices stay in exact correspondence.
SAFETY PROPERTY: a maker is recorded as having submitted if and only if it has a fixed order price, so no maker's opening order is ever recorded twice or lost.

---- MODULE W4Od8m2p6t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Courses, MaxRound
VARIABLES round, cphase, chan, cdecision, cround
vars == <<round, cphase, chan, cdecision, cround>>

PrepMsgs(r) == { [kind |-> "prep", crs |-> c, rnd |-> r] : c \in Courses }
CommitMsgs(r) == { [kind |-> "commit", crs |-> c, rnd |-> r] : c \in Courses }

Init ==
    /\ round = 0
    /\ cphase = "idle"
    /\ chan = {}
    /\ cdecision = [c \in Courses |-> "none"]
    /\ cround = [c \in Courses |-> 0]

StartRound ==
    /\ cphase = "idle"
    /\ round < MaxRound
    /\ round' = round + 1
    /\ cphase' = "preparing"
    /\ chan' = chan \cup PrepMsgs(round + 1)
    /\ cdecision' = [c \in Courses |-> IF cdecision[c] = "committed" THEN "committed" ELSE "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED cround

AcceptPrepare(c) ==
    /\ \E m \in chan : m.kind = "prep" /\ m.crs = c /\ m.rnd = round
    /\ cdecision[c] = "none"
    /\ cdecision' = [cdecision EXCEPT ![c] = "prepared"]
    /\ cround' = [cround EXCEPT ![c] = round]
    /\ chan' = chan \ { m \in chan : m.kind = "prep" /\ m.crs = c /\ m.rnd = round }
    /\ UNCHANGED <<round, cphase>>

CoordCommit ==
    /\ cphase = "preparing"
    /\ \A c \in Courses : cdecision[c] = "prepared"
    /\ cphase' = "committing"
    /\ chan' = chan \cup CommitMsgs(round)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<round, cdecision, cround>>

AcceptCommit(c) ==
    /\ \E m \in chan : m.kind = "commit" /\ m.crs = c /\ m.rnd = round
    /\ cdecision[c] = "prepared"
    /\ cdecision' = [cdecision EXCEPT ![c] = "committed"]
    /\ cround' = [cround EXCEPT ![c] = round]
    /\ chan' = chan \ { m \in chan : m.kind = "commit" /\ m.crs = c /\ m.rnd = round }
    /\ UNCHANGED <<round, cphase>>

DropStale ==
    /\ \E m \in chan : m.rnd < round
    /\ chan' = { m \in chan : m.rnd >= round }
    /\ UNCHANGED <<round, cphase, cdecision, cround>>

FinishRound ==
    /\ cphase = "committing"
    /\ cphase' = "idle"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<round, chan, cdecision, cround>>

Next ==
    \/ StartRound
    \/ \E c \in Courses : AcceptPrepare(c)
    \/ CoordCommit
    \/ \E c \in Courses : AcceptCommit(c)
    \/ DropStale
    \/ FinishRound
    \/ UNCHANGED vars

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoStaleActor ==
    \A c \in Courses : cdecision[c] = "prepared" => cround[c] = round
====

CONSTANTS
    Courses = {m1, m2}
    MaxRound = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleActor
nl:
A university registrar commits batches of course registrations using a two-phase commit across course-seat managers. The registrar runs in numbered rounds and its current round only ever advances. Starting a round advances the round number, moves the registrar into the preparing phase, and broadcasts prepare messages, each stamped with the new round number, to every course manager. Messages travel through an unordered network and may be delivered in any order. A course manager accepts a prepare or commit message only if the message's stamped round equals the registrar's current round, recording the round it acted on; stale messages stamped with an older round are simply discarded. Once every course has prepared, the registrar broadcasts round-stamped commit messages and course managers that had prepared become committed. Beginning a fresh round invalidates any still-prepared (uncommitted) course from the previous round. The guarantee is that no course manager is left acting under a stale, out-of-date round.
SAFETY PROPERTY: any course manager currently in the prepared state recorded the registrar's current round as the round it acted on.

    /\ ver = 0
    /\ snapshot = [w \in Workers |-> 0]
    /\ wstate = [w \in Workers |-> "idle"]

    /\ snapshot' = [snapshot EXCEPT ![w] = ver]
    /\ wstate' = [wstate EXCEPT ![w] = "reading"]

Linger(w) ==

    /\ UNCHANGED vars

TryEnter(w) ==

    /\ owner = NONE
    /\ snapshot[w] = ver
    /\ ver < MaxVer
    /\ owner' = w
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ wstate' = [wstate EXCEPT ![w] = "intable"]
    /\ UNCHANGED snapshot

    /\ snapshot[w] # ver
    /\ wstate' = [wstate EXCEPT ![w] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, ver, snapshot>>

    /\ owner = w
    /\ ver < MaxVer
    /\ owner' = NONE
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ wstate' = [wstate EXCEPT ![w] = "idle"]

    \/ \E w \in Workers : Linger(w)

    \/ \E w \in Workers : RetryFail(w)

CONSTANTS
    Workers = {w1, w2}
    MaxVer = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT SortTableMutex
nl:
An airport baggage router has a single shared sort table that is the critical resource: only one handling worker may be inside it at a time. Access is arbitrated by optimistic locking with retry. The table carries a version counter. A worker first reads the current version into its private snapshot and enters a reading state. It then attempts to enter the table, which succeeds only if the table is currently unoccupied and the version still equals the snapshot it read; on success the worker becomes the occupant and the version is bumped. If in the meantime the version has moved on, the worker's optimistic attempt is abandoned and it returns to idle to retry later. A worker leaves the table by vacating it and bumping the version again. Workers may be arbitrarily slow, lingering in the reading state, but they never fail outright. The router must never allow two workers inside the sort table simultaneously.
SAFETY PROPERTY: a worker is in the in-table state if and only if it is the recorded occupant of the sort table, so at most one worker is ever inside.

---- MODULE W4Od3m6p2t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Accounts, Procs, Total, MaxT, MaxCap, LeaseLen
NONE == "none"
VARIABLES clock, balance, leaseHolder, leaseExp, capacity, activeLeases
vars == <<clock, balance, leaseHolder, leaseExp, capacity, activeLeases>>

RECURSIVE TotalFunds(_)
TotalFunds(S) == IF S = {} THEN 0
                 ELSE LET a == CHOOSE x \in S : TRUE IN balance[a] + TotalFunds(S \ {a})

InitBal(a) == IF a = CHOOSE x \in Accounts : TRUE THEN Total ELSE 0

Init ==
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ balance = [a \in Accounts |-> InitBal(a)]
    /\ leaseHolder = [a \in Accounts |-> NONE]
    /\ leaseExp = [a \in Accounts |-> 0]
    /\ capacity = 1
    /\ activeLeases = 0

AcquireLease(p, a) ==
    /\ leaseHolder[a] = NONE
    /\ activeLeases < capacity
    /\ leaseHolder' = [leaseHolder EXCEPT ![a] = p]
    /\ leaseExp' = [leaseExp EXCEPT ![a] = IF clock + LeaseLen > MaxT THEN MaxT ELSE clock + LeaseLen]
    /\ activeLeases' = activeLeases + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, balance, capacity>>

Transfer(p, a, b) ==
    /\ a # b
    /\ leaseHolder[a] = p
    /\ leaseExp[a] >= clock
    /\ balance[a] > 0
    /\ balance' = [balance EXCEPT ![a] = @ - 1, ![b] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, leaseHolder, leaseExp, capacity, activeLeases>>

ReleaseLease(p, a) ==
    /\ leaseHolder[a] = p
    /\ leaseHolder' = [leaseHolder EXCEPT ![a] = NONE]
    /\ activeLeases' = activeLeases - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, balance, leaseExp, capacity>>

ReclaimLease(a) ==
    /\ leaseHolder[a] # NONE
    /\ leaseExp[a] < clock
    /\ leaseHolder' = [leaseHolder EXCEPT ![a] = NONE]
    /\ activeLeases' = activeLeases - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, balance, leaseExp, capacity>>

Reconfigure(k) ==
    /\ k >= activeLeases
    /\ capacity' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, balance, leaseHolder, leaseExp, activeLeases>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxT
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<balance, leaseHolder, leaseExp, capacity, activeLeases>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Procs, a \in Accounts : AcquireLease(p, a)
    \/ \E p \in Procs, a \in Accounts, b \in Accounts : Transfer(p, a, b)
    \/ \E p \in Procs, a \in Accounts : ReleaseLease(p, a)
    \/ \E a \in Accounts : ReclaimLease(a)
    \/ \E k \in 1 .. MaxCap : Reconfigure(k)
    \/ Tick
    \/ UNCHANGED vars

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

FundsConserved == TotalFunds(Accounts) = Total
====

CONSTANTS
    Accounts = {a1, a2}
    Procs = {p1, p2}
    Total = 2
    MaxT = 2
    MaxCap = 2
    LeaseLen = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT FundsConserved
nl:
A settlement engine moves funds between accounts using time-limited leases. Total funds in the system are fixed; money only ever shifts between accounts, never created or destroyed. To move money out of an account a processor must hold a live lease on it. Acquiring a lease on a free account is only allowed while the number of currently active leases is below the engine's configured lease capacity; the lease is stamped with an expiry on a shared clock. A processor holding a live lease on an account may transfer one unit from that account to any other account. A lease is released explicitly by its holder or reclaimed once its expiry has passed, in either case lowering the active-lease count. The lease capacity is reconfigured at runtime as operational limits change, but never below the number of leases already active. The clock only advances. The engine must conserve money exactly regardless of lease and capacity dynamics.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the sum of all account balances always equals the fixed total funds loaded at initialization.

    /\ leaseHolder = [r \in Runways |-> NONE]
    /\ leaseExp = [r \in Runways |-> 0]
    /\ occupant = [r \in Runways |-> NONE]
    /\ adminGrant = [r \in Runways |-> FALSE]

Lease(f, r) ==
    /\ leaseHolder[r] = NONE
    /\ leaseHolder' = [leaseHolder EXCEPT ![r] = f]
    /\ leaseExp' = [leaseExp EXCEPT ![r] = IF clock + LeaseLen > MaxT THEN MaxT ELSE clock + LeaseLen]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, occupant, adminGrant>>

Occupy(f, r) ==
    /\ leaseHolder[r] = f
    /\ leaseExp[r] >= clock
    /\ occupant[r] = NONE
    /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![r] = f]
    /\ adminGrant' = [adminGrant EXCEPT ![r] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, leaseHolder, leaseExp>>

Vacate(f, r) ==
    /\ occupant[r] = f
    /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![r] = NONE]
    /\ adminGrant' = [adminGrant EXCEPT ![r] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, leaseHolder, leaseExp>>

    /\ leaseHolder[r] # NONE
    /\ leaseExp[r] < clock
    /\ leaseHolder' = [leaseHolder EXCEPT ![r] = NONE]
    /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![r] = IF occupant[r] = leaseHolder[r] THEN NONE ELSE occupant[r]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, leaseExp, adminGrant>>

AdminOverride(f, r) ==
    /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![r] = f]
    /\ adminGrant' = [adminGrant EXCEPT ![r] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, leaseHolder, leaseExp>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxT
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseHolder, leaseExp, occupant, adminGrant>>

Next ==
    \/ \E f \in Flights, r \in Runways : Lease(f, r)
    \/ \E f \in Flights, r \in Runways : Occupy(f, r)
    \/ \E f \in Flights, r \in Runways : Vacate(f, r)
    \/ \E r \in Runways : ExpireLease(r)
    \/ \E f \in Flights, r \in Runways : AdminOverride(f, r)
    \/ Tick
    \/ UNCHANGED vars

    \A r \in Runways :
        occupant[r] # NONE => (adminGrant[r] \/ leaseHolder[r] = occupant[r])

    Flights = {f1, f2}
    MaxT = 2
    LeaseLen = 2
INIT Init

nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator hands out runways to flights using time-limited leases. A free runway may be leased to a flight, stamping the lease with an expiry on a shared clock. A flight holding a live lease on a runway may occupy it for takeoff or landing, becoming the runway's occupant. A flight vacates the runway when done. When a lease expires it is reclaimed: the runway's lease holder is cleared, and if that holder was currently occupying the runway it is forced off as well, so an expired flight cannot linger. A privileged supervisor may issue an emergency override, placing any flight onto any runway as its occupant regardless of leases and preempting whoever was there, and marks that occupancy as admin-granted. The clock only moves forward. The controller must guarantee that a runway is only ever occupied by an authorised flight: either the current lease holder, or a flight placed there by supervisor override.
SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever a runway has an occupant, that occupant is either an admin-granted placement or the runway's current lease holder.

nl:
A container-ship crane yard has one central transfer point that is the critical resource: only one crane may be working at it at a time. Cranes from two different fleets share a single pool and sit on one coordination ring; a single token circulates the ring and only the crane currently holding the token may work the transfer point. The token holder may enter the transfer point provided it is unoccupied, do work there (which counts against its fleet's work tally), and then exit. A crane keeps the token the whole time it is at the transfer point and may only release the token, handing a grant to its ring-neighbour, once it has exited. A dropped grant is delivered to the neighbour to continue the rotation. Because both fleets draw from the same pool and ring, the yard must guarantee that whoever is at the transfer point is exactly the token holder, so the two fleets never collide at the critical point.
SAFETY PROPERTY: any crane at the transfer point is the current holder of the token, so at most one crane from either fleet works the point at a time.

---- MODULE W4Od0m2p2t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Surgeries, Total, MaxCap
VARIABLES budget, reserved, booked, sstate, capacity, prepCount
vars == <<budget, reserved, booked, sstate, capacity, prepCount>>

Init ==
    /\ budget = Total
    /\ reserved = 0
    /\ booked = 0
    /\ sstate = [s \in Surgeries |-> "idle"]
    /\ capacity = 1
    /\ prepCount = 0

Prepare(s) ==
    /\ sstate[s] = "idle"
    /\ budget > 0
    /\ prepCount < capacity
    /\ budget' = budget - 1
    /\ reserved' = reserved + 1
    /\ sstate' = [sstate EXCEPT ![s] = "prepared"]
    /\ prepCount' = prepCount + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<booked, capacity>>

Commit(s) ==
    /\ sstate[s] = "prepared"
    /\ reserved' = reserved - 1
    /\ booked' = booked + 1
    /\ sstate' = [sstate EXCEPT ![s] = "committed"]
    /\ prepCount' = prepCount - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<budget, capacity>>

Abort(s) ==
    /\ sstate[s] = "prepared"
    /\ reserved' = reserved - 1
    /\ budget' = budget + 1
    /\ sstate' = [sstate EXCEPT ![s] = "idle"]
    /\ prepCount' = prepCount - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<booked, capacity>>

Reconfigure(k) ==
    /\ k >= prepCount
    /\ capacity' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<budget, reserved, booked, sstate, prepCount>>

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Surgeries : Prepare(s)
    \/ \E s \in Surgeries : Commit(s)
    \/ \E s \in Surgeries : Abort(s)
    \/ \E k \in 1 .. MaxCap : Reconfigure(k)
    \/ UNCHANGED vars

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

HoursConserved == budget + reserved + booked = Total
====

CONSTANTS
    Surgeries = {s1, s2, s3}
    Total = 2
    MaxCap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT HoursConserved
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler books surgeries against a fixed pool of operating hours using two-phase commit. Every hour of theatre time is always accounted for in exactly one of three places: the free budget, hours reserved by in-flight bookings, or hours already booked. Each surgery needs one hour. In the prepare phase a surgery moves one hour out of the free budget into reserved and becomes prepared, but only while the number of concurrently prepared bookings is below the scheduler's current capacity limit. Committing a prepared surgery moves its reserved hour into booked. Aborting a prepared surgery returns its reserved hour to the free budget. The scheduler's concurrency capacity is reconfigured at runtime as staffing changes, but never below the number of bookings already prepared. No matter how bookings prepare, commit, abort, or how capacity changes, total theatre hours are conserved.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the free budget plus reserved hours plus booked hours always equals the fixed total of operating hours.

---- MODULE W4Od2m8p4t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Robots, Zones, Cap
NONE == "none"
VARIABLES coarse, fine, load, crashed
vars == <<coarse, fine, load, crashed>>

Init ==
    /\ coarse = [z \in Zones |-> NONE]
    /\ fine = [z \in Zones |-> NONE]
    /\ load = [z \in Zones |-> 0]
    /\ crashed = {}

LockZone(rb, z) ==
    /\ rb \notin crashed
    /\ coarse[z] = NONE
    /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![z] = rb]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, load, crashed>>

LockBin(rb, z) ==
    /\ rb \notin crashed
    /\ coarse[z] = rb
    /\ fine[z] = NONE
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![z] = rb]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, load, crashed>>

Place(rb, z) ==
    /\ rb \notin crashed
    /\ coarse[z] = rb
    /\ fine[z] = rb
    /\ load[z] < Cap
    /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![z] = @ + 1]
    /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![z] = NONE]
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![z] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED crashed

Crash(rb) ==
    /\ rb \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {rb}
    /\ coarse' = [z \in Zones |-> IF coarse[z] = rb THEN NONE ELSE coarse[z]]
    /\ fine' = [z \in Zones |-> IF fine[z] = rb THEN NONE ELSE fine[z]]
    /\ UNCHANGED load

Next ==
    \/ \E rb \in Robots, z \in Zones : LockZone(rb, z)
    \/ \E rb \in Robots, z \in Zones : LockBin(rb, z)
    \/ \E rb \in Robots, z \in Zones : Place(rb, z)
    \/ \E rb \in Robots : Crash(rb)
    \/ UNCHANGED vars

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CapacityRespected ==
    \A z \in Zones : load[z] <= Cap
====

CONSTANTS
    Robots = {r1, r2}
    Zones = {z1, z2}
    Cap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapacityRespected
nl:
A fleet of warehouse robots stows items into storage zones, each zone holding at most a fixed capacity of items. Access uses two levels of lock: a coarse lock over an entire zone, and a fine lock on the bin within it. To stow an item a robot must first take the coarse lock on the zone, then take the fine bin lock (which it may only do while already holding that zone's coarse lock). Holding both locks, the robot places one item, which is only permitted while the zone is below its capacity, and then releases both locks. Any robot may crash silently at any moment; on crashing it drops whatever coarse and fine locks it was holding and stops acting. The warehouse controller must guarantee that no zone is ever filled beyond its capacity, no matter how robots interleave or crash.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every storage zone's item count is always less than or equal to its fixed capacity.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od10m5p1t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Controllers, Proposals, Quorum, MaxVer
VARIABLES votes, committed, recorded, version
vars == <<votes, committed, recorded, version>>

Init ==
    /\ votes = [p \in Proposals |-> {}]
    /\ committed = {}
    /\ recorded = [p \in Proposals |-> FALSE]
    /\ version = 0

CastVote(ctl, p) ==
    /\ p \notin committed
    /\ ctl \notin votes[p]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![p] = @ \cup {ctl}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<committed, recorded, version>>

ApplyQuorum(p) ==
    /\ p \notin committed
    /\ Cardinality(votes[p]) >= Quorum
    /\ version < MaxVer
    /\ committed' = committed \cup {p}
    /\ recorded' = [recorded EXCEPT ![p] = TRUE]
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED votes

AdminOverride(p) ==
    /\ p \notin committed
    /\ version < MaxVer
    /\ committed' = committed \cup {p}
    /\ recorded' = [recorded EXCEPT ![p] = TRUE]
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED votes

Next ==
    \/ \E ctl \in Controllers, p \in Proposals : CastVote(ctl, p)
    \/ \E p \in Proposals : ApplyQuorum(p)
    \/ \E p \in Proposals : AdminOverride(p)
    \/ UNCHANGED vars

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdate ==
    \A p \in committed : recorded[p] = TRUE
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Controllers = {c1, c2, c3}
    Proposals = {q1, q2}
    Quorum = 2
    MaxVer = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A subway signalling system maintains a shared block-occupancy record that is updated only through approved proposals. Each proposed change to the record must gather votes from a quorum of signal controllers before it can be applied. Controllers cast votes for pending proposals, one vote each per proposal. Once a proposal has collected at least a quorum of votes it is applied: it is added to the committed set, its write is durably recorded, and the shared record's version is advanced. A privileged dispatcher may issue an emergency override that applies a proposal immediately, bypassing the quorum requirement, but it too must durably record the write. The integrity requirement is that no committed update is ever lost: every proposal that has been committed has its write durably recorded in the shared record.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every proposal in the committed set has its write flag durably recorded, so no committed update is silently lost.

---- MODULE W4Od19m4p4t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Requests, QCap, LoanCap
VARIABLES queue, loaned, rstate, crashed
vars == <<queue, loaned, rstate, crashed>>

Init ==
    /\ queue = {}
    /\ loaned = {}
    /\ rstate = [r \in Requests |-> "new"]
    /\ crashed = {}

Submit(r) ==
    /\ r \notin crashed
    /\ rstate[r] = "new"
    /\ Cardinality(queue) < QCap
    /\ queue' = queue \cup {r}
    /\ rstate' = [rstate EXCEPT ![r] = "queued"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<loaned, crashed>>

Grant(r) ==
    /\ r \in queue
    /\ Cardinality(loaned) < LoanCap
    /\ loaned' = loaned \cup {r}
    /\ queue' = queue \ {r}
    /\ rstate' = [rstate EXCEPT ![r] = "loaned"]
    /\ UNCHANGED crashed

Return(r) ==
    /\ rstate[r] = "loaned"
    /\ loaned' = loaned \ {r}
    /\ rstate' = [rstate EXCEPT ![r] = "returned"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, crashed>>

Crash(r) ==
    /\ r \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {r}
    /\ queue' = queue \ {r}
    /\ rstate' = [rstate EXCEPT ![r] = IF rstate[r] = "queued" THEN "new" ELSE rstate[r]]
    /\ UNCHANGED loaned

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Requests : Submit(r)
    \/ \E r \in Requests : Grant(r)
    \/ \E r \in Requests : Return(r)
    \/ \E r \in Requests : Crash(r)
    \/ UNCHANGED vars

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

LoanCapacityRespected ==
    Cardinality(loaned) <= LoanCap
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Requests = {q1, q2, q3}
    QCap = 2
    LoanCap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT LoanCapacityRespected
nl:
A library reservation desk processes loan requests through a bounded work queue and enforces a hard ceiling on how many books can be on loan at once. A new request is admitted to the work queue only while the queue has spare room, providing backpressure at intake. The desk grants a queued request by issuing a loan, but only while the number of currently active loans is below the loan capacity ceiling; granting moves the request out of the queue and into the loaned set. A loaned book is later returned, freeing a loan slot. A patron may crash silently at any time; a crashed patron stops acting and any request of theirs still waiting in the queue is dropped, though a book already loaned to them stays out until returned. Regardless of how requests queue, grant, return, or how patrons crash, the desk must never exceed its loan capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of books currently on loan never exceeds the fixed loan capacity.

---- MODULE W4Od6m6p2t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Cars, Total, CarCap, MaxT, LeaseLen
VARIABLES clock, waiting, riding, arrived, lease, leaseOn
vars == <<clock, waiting, riding, arrived, lease, leaseOn>>

RECURSIVE SumRiding(_)
SumRiding(S) == IF S = {} THEN 0
                ELSE LET c == CHOOSE x \in S : TRUE IN riding[c] + SumRiding(S \ {c})

Init ==
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ waiting = Total
    /\ riding = [c \in Cars |-> 0]
    /\ arrived = 0
    /\ lease = [c \in Cars |-> 0]
    /\ leaseOn = [c \in Cars |-> FALSE]

AcquireLease(c) ==
    /\ ~leaseOn[c]
    /\ leaseOn' = [leaseOn EXCEPT ![c] = TRUE]
    /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![c] = IF clock + LeaseLen > MaxT THEN MaxT ELSE clock + LeaseLen]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, waiting, riding, arrived>>

Board(c) ==
    /\ leaseOn[c]
    /\ lease[c] >= clock
    /\ waiting > 0
    /\ riding[c] < CarCap
    /\ waiting' = waiting - 1
    /\ riding' = [riding EXCEPT ![c] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, arrived, lease, leaseOn>>

Alight(c) ==
    /\ riding[c] > 0
    /\ riding' = [riding EXCEPT ![c] = @ - 1]
    /\ arrived' = arrived + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, waiting, lease, leaseOn>>

ReleaseLease(c) ==
    /\ leaseOn[c]
    /\ leaseOn' = [leaseOn EXCEPT ![c] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, waiting, riding, arrived, lease>>

ReclaimLease(c) ==
    /\ leaseOn[c]
    /\ lease[c] < clock
    /\ leaseOn' = [leaseOn EXCEPT ![c] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, waiting, riding, arrived, lease>>

Dawdle(c) ==
    /\ leaseOn[c]
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxT
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<waiting, riding, arrived, lease, leaseOn>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cars : AcquireLease(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cars : Board(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cars : Alight(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cars : ReleaseLease(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cars : ReclaimLease(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cars : Dawdle(c)
    \/ Tick
    \/ UNCHANGED vars

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

PassengersConserved ==
    waiting + SumRiding(Cars) + arrived = Total
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Cars = {e1, e2}
    Total = 2
    CarCap = 2
    MaxT = 2
    LeaseLen = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT PassengersConserved
nl:
An elevator bank moves a fixed population of passengers from the lobby to their destinations. Every passenger is always in exactly one place: waiting in the lobby, riding inside some car, or already arrived. A dispatcher assigns work using time-limited service leases: a car acquires a lease to serve the lobby, stamped with an expiry on a shared clock. While holding a live lease a car may board one waiting passenger, provided the car is below its own capacity, moving that passenger from the lobby into the car. A car may let a passenger alight at any time, moving one from the car to arrived. A car releases its lease when done, and an expired lease is reclaimed. Cars may be arbitrarily slow, lingering while holding a lease, but they never fail. The clock only advances. However cars acquire leases, board, alight, or dawdle, the total passenger count must be conserved.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the number waiting in the lobby, plus the total riding across all cars, plus the number arrived, always equals the fixed passenger population.

---- MODULE W4Od4m7p3t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Cars, Bays, MaxVer
NONE == "none"
VARIABLES reg, heldBay, version, requests
vars == <<reg, heldBay, version, requests>>

Init ==
    /\ reg = [b \in Bays |-> NONE]
    /\ heldBay = [c \in Cars |-> NONE]
    /\ version = [b \in Bays |-> 0]
    /\ requests = {}

MakeRequest(c, b) ==
    /\ <<c, b>> \notin requests
    /\ heldBay[c] = NONE
    /\ requests' = requests \cup {<<c, b>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, heldBay, version>>

CasClaim(c, b) ==
    /\ <<c, b>> \in requests
    /\ reg[b] = NONE
    /\ heldBay[c] = NONE
    /\ version[b] < MaxVer
    /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![b] = c]
    /\ heldBay' = [heldBay EXCEPT ![c] = b]
    /\ version' = [version EXCEPT ![b] = @ + 1]
    /\ requests' = requests \ {<<c, b>>}

Release(c, b) ==
    /\ reg[b] = c
    /\ heldBay[c] = b
    /\ version[b] < MaxVer
    /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![b] = NONE]
    /\ heldBay' = [heldBay EXCEPT ![c] = NONE]
    /\ version' = [version EXCEPT ![b] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED requests

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cars, b \in Bays : MakeRequest(c, b)
    \/ \E c \in Cars, b \in Bays : CasClaim(c, b)
    \/ \E c \in Cars, b \in Bays : Release(c, b)
    \/ UNCHANGED vars

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

BayCarAgree ==
    \A b \in Bays : reg[b] \in Cars => heldBay[reg[b]] = b
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Cars = {v1, v2}
    Bays = {y1, y2}
    MaxVer = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT BayCarAgree
nl:
A car-wash site allocates wash bays to arriving cars. Each bay carries an atomic register naming the car that currently owns it (or nobody) plus a version counter. Allocation requests pairing a car with a desired bay accumulate in an unordered request pool and are serviced in arbitrary order. A request is fulfilled by a compare-and-swap: it succeeds only if the target bay's register reads empty and the requesting car does not already hold a bay; on success the register is written with the car, the car's held-bay record is set to that bay, the version is bumped, and the request is consumed. A car releases its bay by clearing both the register and its record and bumping the version. Because requests are serviced out of order and can name the same bay, the site must never allocate one bay to two cars or leave the register and the cars' records disagreeing.
SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever a bay's register names a car, that car's held-bay record names that same bay, so no bay is allocated to two different cars.

EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Nodes, Machines, Total, MaxTerm
NONE == "none"
VARIABLES term, leader, inMachine, collected
vars == <<term, leader, inMachine, collected>>

RECURSIVE SumMachines(_)
SumMachines(S) == IF S = {} THEN 0
                  ELSE LET m == CHOOSE x \in S : TRUE IN inMachine[m] + SumMachines(S \ {m})

InitCoins(m) == IF m = CHOOSE x \in Machines : TRUE THEN Total ELSE 0

Init ==
    /\ term = 0
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ inMachine = [m \in Machines |-> InitCoins(m)]
    /\ collected = 0

Elect(n) ==
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inMachine, collected>>

FailLeader(n) ==
    /\ leader = n
    /\ leader' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, inMachine, collected>>

Collect(n, m) ==
    /\ leader = n
    /\ inMachine[m] > 0
    /\ inMachine' = [inMachine EXCEPT ![m] = @ - 1]
    /\ collected' = collected + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader>>

AdminCollect(m) ==
    /\ inMachine[m] > 0
    /\ inMachine' = [inMachine EXCEPT ![m] = @ - 1]
    /\ collected' = collected + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : FailLeader(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes, m \in Machines : Collect(n, m)
    \/ \E m \in Machines : AdminCollect(m)

    Nodes = {n1, n2}
    Machines = {mA, mB}
    Total = 2
    MaxTerm = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CashConserved
nl:
A network of vending machines is coordinated by controller nodes that elect a single leader to authorise cash collection. Every coin in the network is always either sitting inside some machine or already collected into the central safe; the total coin count is fixed. Running an election advances the term and installs a new leader; the sitting leader may fail, vacating leadership until a fresh election (failover). Only the current leader may authorise a collection, which moves one coin out of a chosen machine into the collected safe. A privileged operator may also perform an emergency collection directly, bypassing the leader, again moving one coin from a machine into the safe. However leaders are elected, fail, authorise collections, or the operator overrides, no coin is ever created or lost.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the sum of coins still inside all machines plus the coins in the collected safe always equals the fixed total number of coins.

---- MODULE W4Od17m3p0t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Nodes, MaxTerm
NONE == "none"
VARIABLES term, leader, operating, byAdmin
vars == <<term, leader, operating, byAdmin>>

    /\ term = 0
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ operating = [n \in Nodes |-> FALSE]
    /\ byAdmin = [n \in Nodes |-> FALSE]

Elect(n) ==
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<operating, byAdmin>>

Operate(n) ==
    /\ leader = n
    /\ ~operating[n]
    /\ \A m \in Nodes : ~operating[m]
    /\ operating' = [operating EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE]
    /\ byAdmin' = [byAdmin EXCEPT ![n] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader>>

Stop(n) ==
    /\ operating[n]
    /\ operating' = [operating EXCEPT ![n] = FALSE]
    /\ byAdmin' = [byAdmin EXCEPT ![n] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader>>

FailLeader(n) ==
    /\ leader = n
    /\ leader' = NONE
    /\ operating' = [operating EXCEPT ![n] = IF byAdmin[n] THEN operating[n] ELSE FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, byAdmin>>

AdminSeize(n) ==
    /\ operating' = [m \in Nodes |-> m = n]
    /\ byAdmin' = [m \in Nodes |-> m = n]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Operate(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Stop(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : FailLeader(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : AdminSeize(n)

DiverterMutex ==
    \A n1 \in Nodes, n2 \in Nodes :
        (operating[n1] /\ operating[n2]) => n1 = n2
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Nodes = {n1, n2}
    MaxTerm = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT DiverterMutex
nl:
An airport baggage router has one motorised diverter that is the critical resource: at most one controller node may be operating it at any instant. Controller nodes elect a single leader, and normally only the current leader may take the diverter. Running an election advances the term and installs a new leader. A node operates the diverter only when it is the leader and no node is currently operating it; it later stops, freeing the diverter. The sitting leader may fail, vacating leadership, and if it was operating the diverter under its leadership it is forced to stop. A privileged operator may seize the diverter directly at any time, bypassing the leader requirement and preempting whoever held it, becoming the sole operator marked as an admin seizure. The overriding safety requirement is that two nodes never operate the diverter at the same time.
SAFETY PROPERTY: no two distinct controller nodes are ever both operating the diverter simultaneously.
